text: Because systemic risk disclosures are far more generic and are not tailored to any specific distressed investment, importing them into bankruptcy would improve only marginally the information available about the motives of distressed securities investors.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Hedge Funds’ Systemic Risk Disclosures in Bankruptcy (2013). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2348463

isBasedOn.name: Hedge Funds’ Systemic Risk Disclosures in Bankruptcy

abstract: Hence, with regard to disclosure of possible motives of hedge fund investors in bankruptcy, systemic risk disclosures in the bankruptcy context would only marginally improve the availability of relevant information pertaining to possible motives of distressed securities investors.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: Form PF disclosures in their current generic form
